title: The Eisenstein congruence modulo 5 for the newform of level 11
abstract: The newform f(z) = η(z)²η(11z)² = q∏(1 − qⁿ)²(1 − q¹¹ⁿ)² = ∑a(n)qⁿ of weight 2 and level 11 (LMFDB 11.2.a.a, the modular form of the elliptic curves of conductor 11) is congruent modulo 5 to the Eisenstein series of its level: a(n) ≡ ∑_{d | n, 11 ∤ d} d (mod 5) for every n ≥ 1, and in particular a(p) ≡ 1 + p (mod 5) for every prime p ≠ 11. It is the weight-2, level-11 analogue of Ramanujan's τ(n) ≡ σ₁₁(n) (mod 691); 5 is the numerator of (11 − 1)/12. Method, as for 691: (1) the lattice L = B ⊕ B with B = (2 1; 1 6), the norm form of x² + xy + 3y² of discriminant −11, is even of rank 4, level dividing 11 and determinant 11², so its theta series θ is a modular form of weight 2 on Γ₀(11) with trivial character (Hecke–Schoeneberg), with integer coefficients r(n) and r(0) = 1; (2) at prime level a weight-2 form minus the Eisenstein multiple with the same constant term at ∞ is a cusp form, so θ = Ẽ + c·f with Ẽ = (E₂(z) − 11E₂(11z))/(−10) = 1 + (12/5)∑σ*(n)qⁿ, because the cusp forms are the multiples of f; (3) comparing coefficients, 5r(n) = 12σ*(n) + (5r(1) − 12)a(n), so 5 divides 12(σ*(n) − a(n)).
